name: Notational Velocity desktop app clone in Godot

mentions.name: Notational Velocity desktop app clone in Godot
mentions.description: This app is a desktop note-taking app modeled on Notational Velocity, built in Godot. It is intentionally simple, centered around plain text files and editing speed, and is currently a work-in-progress prototype good enough to dog-food, with plans to eventually distribute it as a multi-platform app.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of having notes spread everywhere on uncomfortable software.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Tired of having my notes spread everywhere, on uncomfortable software, I'm writing my own Notational Velocity desktop app clone in Godot:

https://share.combo.cc/-Z7hBzNbaCc
